descs.zh-CN: 一枚会轻响的黄铜鱼鳞坠，认真记着每一条不起眼的收获。
descs.en-US: A chiming brass scale that remembers every unassuming catch.

titleNames.en-US: Making a Big Deal of Crucians

descs.zh-CN: 红绳扎成两撇神气的鲤须，风一吹就像又有鱼在试探。
descs.en-US: A jaunty red knot shaped like carp whiskers, twitching at the faintest breeze.

descs.zh-CN: 蓝釉小圆片在阳光下亮得招摇，像一尾绝不肯低调的太阳鱼。
descs.en-US: A blue-glazed sun disc as bright and unapologetic as its namesake.

descs.zh-CN: 用晒干河草编成的细长漂标，闻起来总像刚下过雨。
descs.en-US: A slender float braided from dried rivergrass, forever scented with rain.

descs.zh-CN: 泥釉烧成的小哨子，声音滑溜得像有什么从手里逃走了。
descs.en-US: A mud-glazed whistle whose slippery note seems to wriggle free.

descs.zh-CN: 一枚像黑鳍般利落的金属扣，专门提醒人别和倔鱼讲道理。
descs.en-US: A sharp blackfin clasp and a reminder never to reason with stubborn fish.

descs.zh-CN: 莲纹与锦鲤叠在一枚小签上，好运多得像有点用力过猛。
descs.en-US: Lotus and koi motifs crowd one tiny token with almost excessive good fortune.

descs.zh-CN: 一片永远带着余温的赤铜鳞，冬夜握着格外舍不得放手。
descs.en-US: A red-copper scale that keeps a stubborn warmth through winter nights.

descs.zh-CN: 斑点羽片嵌进旧匙形亮片里，转动时像河面闪过一截褐影。
descs.en-US: A feather-speckled spoon lure that flashes like a brown shadow in current.

descs.zh-CN: 圆润河石上留着笨拙鱼印，像某位河湾熟客亲自盖的章。
descs.en-US: A smooth river stone stamped with the clumsy seal of a familiar chub.

descs.zh-CN: 细得几乎没分量的银针，会为最轻的一次试口微微颤动。
descs.en-US: A nearly weightless silver needle that trembles at the gentlest nibble.

descs.zh-CN: 带双须刻纹的沉底环，拿在手里就能想起河床那股拧劲。
descs.en-US: A whisker-etched sink ring weighted with the stubborn pull of the riverbed.

descs.zh-CN: 墨绿与金色竖纹排得一丝不苟，像河鲈自己审过稿。
descs.en-US: Green and gold stripes arranged with the exacting approval of a perch.

descs.zh-CN: 银鳗绕着月石盘成一圈，怎么看都像准备趁夜溜走。
descs.en-US: A silver eel coils around moonstone, apparently plotting its nightly escape.

descs.zh-CN: 透明鱼棱把一滴雨光分成细碎虹色，转眼又藏得无影无踪。
descs.en-US: A clear fish prism that splits one raindrop into a fleeting rainbow.

descs.zh-CN: 两根蓝银长须护着一枚小铃，没打雷时也偶尔自己响。
descs.en-US: Twin blue-silver whiskers guard a bell that occasionally rings before thunder.

descs.zh-CN: 冰蓝匙形章总是凉得恰到好处，像从深湖刚捞上来。
descs.en-US: An ice-blue spoon medal, always as cool as if lifted from deep water.

descs.zh-CN: 霜白珠里浮着几点暖红，靠近耳边仿佛能听见冰层轻裂。
descs.en-US: Warm red flecks float in a frost-white bead that whispers of cracking ice.

descs.zh-CN: 深色鱼钩托着豆大冷光，专为那些不肯睡的河底夜晚。
descs.en-US: A dark hook cradles a cold pinprick of light for sleepless river nights.

descs.zh-CN: 几片珠白薄鳞叠成小扇，迎光时像一捧没来得及化的雪。
descs.en-US: Pearl-white scales fan into a small handful of snow that never melts.

descs.zh-CN: 长吻金属夹咬合得干脆，多少保留了白斑狗鱼的坏脾气。
descs.en-US: A longsnout clip with a decisive bite and much of a pike's temperament.

descs.zh-CN: 轻羽染成高高的旗鳍纹样，抛出去时连风都像有了方向。
descs.en-US: A light feather dyed like a tall sail fin, lending direction even to wind.

descs.zh-CN: 月白镜盘里总有一尾鲤影慢慢游过，却从不肯停在正中。
descs.en-US: A koi shadow circles a moon-white mirror, never pausing at its center.

descs.zh-CN: 霜银骨片排成沉稳小冠，握住时仿佛有一艘船在冰下转身。
descs.en-US: Frost-silver scutes form a quiet crown, heavy as a ship turning below ice.

names.ja: レイクホワイトフィッシュ

descriptions.zh-CN: 芦苇、睡莲和缓坡浅水组成的暖水湾。
descriptions.zh-TW: 蘆葦、睡蓮和緩坡淺水組成的暖水灣。
descriptions.en-US: A warm bay of reeds, lilies, and gently sloping shallows.
descriptions.ja: 葦と睡蓮が広がる、穏やかな暖水の入り江。
descriptions.ko: 갈대와 수련이 어우러진 완만한 온수 만입니다.
descriptions.ru: Теплый залив с камышом, кувшинками и пологим мелководьем.

descriptions.zh-CN: 清流穿过砾石滩、深潭和倒木岸。
descriptions.zh-TW: 清流穿過礫石灘、深潭和倒木岸。
descriptions.en-US: A clear river winding past gravel runs, deep pools, and fallen timber.
descriptions.ja: 瀬、深み、倒木の岸を縫う澄んだ川。
descriptions.ko: 자갈 여울과 깊은 소, 쓰러진 나무를 지나는 맑은 강입니다.
descriptions.ru: Чистая река с галечными перекатами, омутами и затопленными деревьями.

descriptions.zh-CN: 雪线下的寒冷深湖，陡岸与暗色水层藏着大鱼。
descriptions.zh-TW: 雪線下的寒冷深湖，陡岸與暗色水層藏著大魚。
descriptions.en-US: A cold, steep-sided lake where large fish hold in dark water below the snowline.
descriptions.ja: 雪線の下、暗い深場に大魚が潜む急深の湖。
descriptions.ko: 설선 아래 어두운 수심에 큰 물고기가 머무는 차가운 호수입니다.
descriptions.ru: Холодное глубокое озеро под снежной линией, где крупная рыба держится в темной воде.
